scenarios.name: Prepare speech before capture
scenarios.given: the speech model is not yet prepared
scenarios.then: the transcriber is prepared before capture starts

manual.reason: Installed Mac audio and TCC cannot be accepted by a headless test.
steps: Install the candidate with the stable Dev signing identity.
Play known system speech and verify actual transcript lines labeled OTHERS; inspect affected controls and capture screenshots.
Preserve source/signing evidence and clean only the completed Dev session according to AGENTS.md.

scenarios.name: Allocate readable workspace panes
scenarios.given: the workspace offers room for different reading priorities
scenarios.then: requested reading space is allocated without sacrificing minimum widths

scenarios.name: Finish or cancel a prepared import even when one speech channel received no audio
scenarios.given: native on-device speech channels are prepared with installed English assets and either one or neither channel receives audio
scenarios.when: the file ends or the user cancels the prepared import
scenarios.then: finalization returns promptly, closes result streams, retains the first and final spoken words with source and audio time, and creates no speech or failure status from intentionally unused channels

manual.reason: Native transcriber tests do not inspect installed Start/New controls.
steps: Import the synthetic Orion file once as Others and once as You; inspect final words and source labels.
Verify the import progress disappears and Start/New/Import controls become available.
Cancel a separate import and confirm controls return with incomplete-import guidance.

scenarios.name: Present delayed channel results in recording order without changing capture identity
scenarios.given: a known recording has delayed finalized results from two channels, including identical times and lines with unavailable timestamps
scenarios.when: the user reads or exports the transcript and later reopens or edits a line
scenarios.then: timed lines within each explicit run display in stable chronological order, unknown boundaries remain intact, and capture IDs, times, source, saved arrival order and editing targets are preserved; duration sums known recording spans without mistaking a delayed channel for a new recording, while legacy records retain timestamp-based fallback

manual.reason: Core projection assertions do not prove rendered Mac rows or physical echo suppression.
steps: Install the source-matched candidate; reproduce delayed two-channel finalization and inspect chronological rendered text.
Confirm edit, speaker rename and saved-audio selection still address the intended line after display order changes.
Keep playback echo acceptance separate; do not mark issue336 complete on ordering tests alone.

scenarios.name: Protect microphone capture from device playback echo and clean up failed or stopped engines
scenarios.given: Mac listening uses microphone and system audio, or the input route changes or setup fails
scenarios.when: the microphone starts, recovers from a stopped engine, or the user presses Stop
scenarios.then: echo control is configured before the tap format is read; failure never silently starts raw input; only unchanged route, tap format and voice profile configuration notifications do not restart capture; failed setup cleans the tap and Stop prevents future recovery; a real route failure inside the recovery cooldown suspends unsafe input and retries after the cooldown unless Stop intervenes

manual.reason: Injected engine tests prove setup and lifecycle, not acoustic echo attenuation or native route compatibility.
steps: Confirm Listening and both channels active before synthetic playback. Playback-only speech must appear as OTHERS without duplicate YOU.
Verify independent microphone speech and overlapping or genuinely repeated speech remain; do not remove transcripts by matching words.
Check headphone and speaker routes, route changes, Stop and setup failure recovery in the installed signed candidate.

scenarios.name: Open a final transcript line editor with a native double click while retaining text selection
scenarios.given: two finalized transcript lines and an unfinished line are rendered in the Mac transcript with selectable text
scenarios.when: the user double clicks a finalized line, selects and copies text, or uses the accessible edit action
scenarios.then: the intended final line opens its editor without changing adjacent text or metadata, copying retains the selected phrase, and unfinished text cannot be edited; wrapped Latin and CJK lines remain fully visible across resize and a same-text refresh preserves the active selection

manual.reason: Native hosted event tests do not establish installed app pointer, keyboard, layout or saved-conversation acceptance.
steps: Double-click actual selectable final text in the installed signed candidate; verify the editor contains only that line.
Select and copy a phrase, cancel and save a correction; inspect original timestamp/source and adjacent rows.
Verify partial text has no edit action and capture screenshots; preserve evidence and clean the completed Dev session.
